reason_not_in.cursor: It reads Claude Code's shell calls and the test reports hub records for them.

pr-tested.does: Record how a commit was tested with pr-tested run or texts, for the PR test gate to read. pr-tested show prints a report.

does: Stops a push to a branch with an open PR, a new PR and marking a PR ready until the commit has a passing test report. A new PR also needs a body that says how it was tested and what was not.

children.does: Stops a push to a branch with an open PR, a new PR and marking a PR ready until the commit has a passing test report.
Stops a new PR or a body edit whose body does not say how it was tested and what was not.
